title: Blender 5.3 native AgX sRGB view, declared Float16 native 57³ lookup
scope: Provenance and retained notices for the native AgX view helper and repacked lookup data. This record does not make a determination of copyrightability or definitive legal coverage for all AgX contributions.

delivered.encoding: Zstd; reversible channel-wise modulo 2^16 second-difference/zigzag16 two-byte-planar encoding of IEEE754 Float16 words
delivered.precision: Each original native Float32 LUT sample rounded once to Float16 nearest-even. No resampling, resizing, creative colour edits or polynomial substitution.
delivered.interpolation: Actual OCIO tetrahedral interpolation, NEAREST sampling of RGBA16F 3D texture

testedPrototype.productionDifference: Comments and insignificant shader whitespace only; numerical operations, constants and shader tokens are preserved.

helper.output: Linear display sRGB; subsequent OutputPass performs sRGB OETF only
helper.exposure: Explicit residual cameraExposureEV before native view. Runtime scene already includes cameraRadiometricMultiplier40 for Snow17; never multiply by40 again.
helper.optimizedChain: Actual OCIO optimized Rec.709→FilmLight E-Gamut matrix, log2 allocation of 25 stops, native 57³ tetrahedral LUT, pow2.4

observations: Lists OpenColorIO library 2.5.0, Copyright Contributors to the OpenColorIO Project.
Contains neither AgX nor Filmic. Does not explicitly identify the AgX lookup data.

steps: Load the actual installed Blender config and AgX/None/sRGB reference at exposure0/gamma1.
Extract the losslessly optimized OCIO GLSL ES3 linear-output chain and actual native57³ texture data.
Preserve an exact Float32 reference in the ignored build artifacts.
Round each native sample to Float16 nearest-even once, then encode/reconstruct those Float16 words losslessly.
Retain historical config and OCIO software notices separately, preserving exact notice bytes.

validation.gpu: Chrome and WebKit actual native view + OETF-only OutputPass: 40,413 cases at 0.5/1/2 exposure each, all final RGB bytes within 1 display code of actual OCIO; browser readback hashes identical. No full-app performance claim.

limitations: This package reproduces the specified SDR AgX/None/sRGB reference view; it does not provide other artistic looks, HDR display transforms or white-balance controls.
Float16 precision is declared and bounded by the linked CPU/GPU measurements; the asset is not an exact Float32 copy.
Pointwise view conversion may amplify existing image variation but does not originate the separate baked spatial star pattern.
Final scene tone/exposure handshake, thumbnails, complete shared transfer budget and app performance are integration checks owned separately.
Retained historical/config/software notices are not represented as an independent all-contributor AgX-specific license grant.
